Page.Title: Utilities Toolbox
Page.Subtitle: A practical workspace for connectivity diagnostics and escaped text or JSON cleanup without leaving the Monica shell.

Connectivity.Title: Connectivity Probe
Connectivity.Subtitle: Validate DNS resolution, TCP reachability, and optional HTTP or HTTPS responsiveness from the current host.
Connectivity.PortPlaceholder: Leave empty to use protocol default
Connectivity.AllowInvalidCertificateHelper: Useful for internal environments with self-signed certificates. Leave disabled for normal TLS validation.
Connectivity.HintTcp: Use TCP mode to verify whether the target port is reachable through routing and firewall rules.
Connectivity.HintHttp: Use HTTP or HTTPS mode when you also want to confirm that an application responds after the transport handshake succeeds.
Connectivity.NoResultSubtitle: Provide a target host and start a probe to inspect reachability, latency, and HTTP response details.
Connectivity.ResultSubtitle: A network failure is still a useful diagnostic outcome. The tool reports the failure instead of hiding it behind a generic exception.

TextJson.Title: Text && JSON Cleanup
TextJson.Subtitle: Decode JSON-style escape sequences, format JSON with readable Unicode output, or minify payloads for transport.
TextJson.InputPlaceholder: Paste escaped text or JSON here
TextJson.Hint: Format and minify keep Unicode readable instead of converting characters such as Chinese back into \uXXXX sequences.
TextJson.NoOutputSubtitle: Paste escaped text or JSON, then run one of the actions above.

Messages.ProbeFailed: Probe reached the target but reported a failure.
Messages.OutputReused: Output moved back into the input editor.
